title: Deciphering the Leading-Edge Spatiotemporal Microenvironment of Hepatocellular Carcinoma for Targeted Drug Discovery Using SpaPred.
snippet: The leading-edge (LE) of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a critical region driving malignant progression and is closely associated with high patient mortality and marked intratumoral heterogeneity. Multi-omics integration identified elevated expression of SPARC and IGFBP7 in the LE region, which was associated with stromal remodeling-related transcription...
